schema.title: Synthetic election statement-of-votes pivot schema
schema.description: Extract the county header, the per-contest column definitions, and every precinct row from a precinct-by-precinct Statement of Votes Cast. Each contest is a pivot grid: rows are precincts, columns are the contest's candidates plus Write-In / Over Votes / Under Votes. The same precincts repeat in every contest. Do NOT extract the bold 'Total' row -- it is a column summary, not a precinct.

jurisdiction.description: County named in the page header, e.g. 'Goshen County'.

election_title.description: Report title from the header, e.g. 'Official Precinct-by-Precinct Summary'.

election_date.description: Election date printed in the header, e.g. 'November 5, 2024'.

contests.description: One entry per contest (one per page), defining its columns in order.

office.description: Contest title printed above the grid, e.g. 'United States Senator'.

columns.description: Data column headers left-to-right (candidates then Write-In, Over Votes, Under Votes); aligns positionally with each row's votes.

precinct_results.description: Every precinct row of every contest, in document order. Excludes the 'Total' summary row printed at the foot of each contest.

office.description: Contest this row belongs to (the page's title heading).

votes.description: Vote counts in printed column order, aligned to this contest's 'columns' (candidates, then Write-In, Over Votes, Under Votes).

source_page.description: One-indexed PDF page where the row is printed.
